column1: # The median general-acute hospital wrote off 1.7% of billed charges as bad debt or charity care in FY2023.

# Source: Bad debt plus charity discounts (HCAI line 355, "Other"; Hill-Burton and restricted donations are not included), divided by gross patient revenue. Median of 265 to 272 general-acute hospitals each year. HCAI annual disclosure data, computed on this site. *FY2024 is preliminary.
